course_name_en: Specialization 5: Product Development and Production Systems
prerequisites: Basic knowledge in product and production management, CAD construction, manufacturing and assembly technology, project management, operational cost accounting

learning_outcomes.text: Transfer knowledge from product management, design theory, production management, manufacturing technology, project management and operational cost accounting to an integrative project.
Independently process an existing product under given framework conditions.
Systematically analyze the existing product from manufacturing and assembly technical aspects.
Formulate understandable proposals for improvement measures such as part reduction.
Plan manufacturing and assembly, including necessary fixtures and tools, in a targeted manner.
Implement the manufacturing of functional prototypes using additive manufacturing processes in a practical way.
Calculate production costs at the conclusion of the planning phase.
Plan collaboration in the project team in a goal-oriented manner.
Present ideas and development results in an audience-appropriate manner.
Reliably name requirements, milestones, and submission criteria of the project.
Plan work and time schedules for task processing in individual, partner, and group work in a goal-oriented manner.
Constructively discuss feedback from ongoing assessment, including peer feedback.
Write technical protocols, reports, and project documents structured according to specifications.
Formulate team roles, communication channels, and coordination rules in the project in an understandable manner.
Present work results and project results in the final presentation in an audience-appropriate manner.

syllabus_topics: Operational cost accounting and greenhouse gas accounting

assessment_methods.method: Ongoing assessment of project progress and submitted documents
Written or oral examination for the lecture

assessment_rules: The lecture is assessed by a written or oral examination. Ongoing assessment of project progress and submitted documents, as well as a final project presentation, contribute to the evaluation. Assessment modalities are specified in the information system for studies and teaching before the start of each semester.
